name: webrtc-study
description: 영상, 음성, 채팅을 위한 소규모 자체 호스팅 WebRTC 스터디룸입니다.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names signaling,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:signaling" "npm run dev -w @round/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @round/protocol && npm run build -w @round/rtc-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:signaling && npm run build -w @round/web
scripts.build:web:baton: VITE_ROUND_AUTH_MODE=baton VITE_SIGNALING_URL= VITE_TURN_CREDENTIALS_URL= npm run build -w @round/web -- --mode baton
scripts.build:baton: npm run build:packages && npm run build:signaling && npm run build:web:baton
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @round/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @round/rtc-core && npm run typecheck -w @round/web && ./gradlew --no-daemon :apps:signaling:compileJava :apps:signaling:compileTestJava
scripts.test: npm run test -w @round/protocol && npm run test -w @round/rtc-core && npm run test -w @round/web && ./gradlew --no-daemon :apps:signaling:test
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:typescript && npm run check:java
scripts.check:web: npm run typecheck -w @round/web && npm run test -w @round/web --
scripts.check:typescript: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @round/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @round/rtc-core && npm run test -w @round/protocol && npm run test -w @round/rtc-core && npm run build -w @round/web && npm run test -w @round/web
